svg.title: Project constellation — 60 projects in 21 folders
svg.desc: A terminal session that loops every 2:07. j@sectorg starts in ~/Projects, lists the 5 areas, then enters each area and each of its folders in turn and runs gview. gview opens a folder window in which every project is a holographic trading card: the cards are dealt face down, turn over and rock from side to side with a rainbow foil, and each carries the project's name, its GitHub stars, its language and a small 3D model of the project turning inside the card. The folders and their projects: Vulnerability-Security-Research (19): Connected_Public_Safety_and_Anti-Crime_Technology — anti-crime-ecosystem-research, BirdShot, Flock-Safety-Trap-Shooter-Sniffer-Alarm, onvif-enum, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, verkada-verkracked-alarm-hub-local-framework, verkada-verkracked-subghz-framework, CVE-2017-16744-and-CVE-2017-16748-Tridium-Niagara, flock-safety-falcon-sparrow-alpr-edl-firehose, verkada-verkracked-bullet-cam-cloud-emulator, VerkEye, verkada-verkracked-ambrella-CB62-firmwaredumper; Software — macos-printer-simulator-security-research, AOL-Desktop-Gold-Security-Research; Automotive_V2X_Security — 3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research, Wireless-Attack-Vectors-Against-Automobiles; Hardware_Embedded_Security — Little-Tikes-DreamProjector-Reverse-Engineering; Research_Companion_Material — Phrack-72-Raw-Output-V2X. Technical-Walkthroughs (5): Tutorials_Build_Guides — Qwen 3.6 Tool-Call Fix, M5NanoC6-Zigbee-Sniffer, CloudGoatTutorial; Lectures_Educational_Material — Silk-Road-Lecture; Workflow_Guides — n8n-workflow-whisper-server. Offensive-Tooling (16): Fuzzing_Adversarial_Testing — DWARF; Reconnaissance_Enumeration — crt.sh-OSX; OSINT — LeakScope, Dorker, FOSINT, Base-Google-Dorks; Assessment_Workflow — GoldenNuggets-1, TreeHouse-Wordlists, Hackers-LunchBox, Mac-OSX-Application-Fingerprint-And-Security-Tool, Quick-Engagement-Directory-Maker; Wireless_Device_Tooling — gainsec-in-the-middle, Weaponized-Mousejack-Keysniff; Payload_Bypass_Research — RTLOify; Legacy_Tooling — vncpwn, LeakLooker-X---2022. Open-Public-Source-Projects (19): Hardware_Embedded — AutoProber, RapidPower-RoboDog, Super-Awesome-AI-Driver; RF_Wireless — Tree-House-Defense-System-TDS, M5Stack-Core2-PaxCounter-WiFi-Bluetooth-Monitor; LLM_ML_AI_Agents — ArcticBase, BattleReadyArmor-Slim, battlereadyarmor-pilot, MacOS-ImagePlayground-Improved, AgentReadyArmor-Teaser, tensorflow-generic-harness, BattleReadyArmor-PublicPreview, GainSec-Local-AI-Stack, MacOS-AppleIntelligence-Harness, RealHermes; Applications_Utilities — PineapplePager-Themer, Homarr-Integrations-Widgets, unicode-secret-message; Data_Visualization — SectorMap. Everything-Else (1): Experiments — IG-Clone-Tracker. Viewers who ask for reduced motion see the folder tree with the number of projects in each folder instead.
